items.title: Chester Zardis Interview, 1966-03-09
items.q: George was older than me. George Washington... And George Washington worked with him. Yeah. George used to work with him.

ctx.x: Buddy Mann today looks a little older than me.
Yeah he was older than anybody see. And George was older than me. George Washington.
Do you know anything about him, where he came from or what part of town or who he played with? Who else? I know he played with Buddy for Tebitt. I wonder who else.
